name: Castaway Harem
source:
Flight 119 never made it to Auckland. You wake up on a beach with one sock, no plane and no idea how to swim, and by the second morning you find out you're not the only one who made it.

Nobody has come looking yet. Pick up whatever the sea washes in, build a camp, find water, learn to swim and then to dive. And get to know the women stuck here with you.

[From [url=https://immoralstudios.itch.io/castaway-harem]Steam[/url]]
translation:
119号航班终究没能飞抵奥克兰。你在海滩上醒来，浑身只剩一只袜子，飞机不见踪影，自己更是个旱鸭子；而到了第二天早晨，你才发现幸存下来的人并非只有你一个。

救援至今毫无音讯。捡拾大海冲上岸的一切物资、搭建营地、寻找淡水、学会游泳再去尝试潜水——同时好好认识一下与你一同困在岛上的女人们吧。

[摘自[url=https://immoralstudios.itch.io/castaway-harem]Steam[/url]]
